subject: Re: Acme Corp POC kickoff - scope & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acmecorp.com>, Jenna Lee <jenna.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Corp POC kickoff - scope & next steps

Hi Samir / Jenna —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned before the kickoff: 

Pain points you shared:
- Customer support search is unreliable for long-tail answers (high false negatives).
- Agent-assist latency makes internal agents avoid using the tool.
- High cost per token with current vendor; needs cost predictability for peak hours.

Goals for POC (90 days):
- Improve relevant search recall by +15–20% on our NPS test set.
- Deliver median agent-assist latency <= 350ms for short queries (95th pct target 800ms).
- Demonstrate a cost profile <= $0.02 / 1k tokens for typical workload (with batching and caching).

Scope / success metrics (what we'll measure):
- Evaluation dataset: your 5k customer transcripts + 500 labeled queries (ACME-TESTSET-1).
- Metrics: recall@5, exact-match for KB retrieval, median & 95th latency for 300ms, cost per active session.
- Acceptance criteria: recall uplift >=15% on labeled set AND median latency <=350ms.

Owners & roles:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, POC lead), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineering, infra + latency tuning), Aditya Rao (Customer Success, onboarding & billing).
- Acme: Samir Gupta (Product Sponsor), Jenna Lee (Engineering lead / dataset & infra access).

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff & access setup.
- Week 1: dataset delivery + test prompts.
- Weeks 2–4: model runs, prompt tuning, baseline evals.
- Weeks 5–8: integration + latency optimization.
- Week 12: POC closeout & recommendation.

Access/setup items we need from Acme (Jenna):
1) S3 read-only link to the transcript bucket OR an SFTP account (sample & manifest).
2) Test account for your internal agent UI (or a mock UI session trace).
3) Expected QPS profile (peak & p50) and token distribution sample.

Attachments: acme_poc_scope_v1.pdf (scope & metrics doc), acme_prompt_set_v1.csv (seed prompts & eval pairs).

Please confirm owners and whether you can provide the S3 access by next Wed (2028-03-22). If that works, we’ll target kickoff next Thu (2028-03-23) at 10:00am PT.

Thanks — excited to get started.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
